name: Suspicious Command Patterns In Scheduled Task Creation
description: Detects scheduled task creation using "schtasks" that contain potentially suspicious or uncommon commands
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Software installers that run from temporary folders and also install scheduled tasks are expected to generate some false positives
query: (process.executable:*\\schtasks.exe AND process.command_line:*\/Create\ *) AND (((process.command_line:(*\/sc\ minute\ * OR *\/ru\ system\ *)) AND (process.command_line:(*cmd\ \/c* OR *cmd\ \/k* OR *cmd\ \/r* OR *cmd.exe\ \/c\ * OR *cmd.exe\ \/k\ * OR *cmd.exe\ \/r\ *))) OR (process.command_line:(*\ \-decode\ * OR *\ \-enc\ * OR *\ \-w\ hidden\ * OR *\ bypass\ * OR *\ IEX* OR *.DownloadData* OR *.DownloadFile* OR *.DownloadString* OR *\/c\ start\ \/min\ * OR *FromBase64String* OR *mshta\ http* OR *mshta.exe\ http*)) OR ((process.command_line:(*\:\\ProgramData\\* OR *\:\\Temp\\* OR *\:\\Tmp\\* OR *\:\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\:\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR *\\AppData\\* OR *%AppData%* OR *%Temp%* OR *%tmp%*)) AND (process.command_line:(*cscript* OR *curl* OR *wscript*))))
